title: Pathfinder onboarding assets for Optimize: compact walkthrough, tuning cards, and quant UI snippets
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a compact, first-run experience (Pathfinder) for the Optimize toolkit that surfaces batching, KV-caching, and quantization suggestions. Deliver a set of visual assets and screenshot-ready UI snippets for docs and release notes. Deliverables include compact walkthrough cards, inline tooltips for quantization toggles, a simplified KV cache visualization, desktop and narrow-mobile screenshots, and microcopy for each step. The goal is to reduce time-to-value for new users by making recommended tuning actions discoverable and quick to act on from the Console within the first 3 minutes of onboarding.
acceptance_criteria: Three compact walkthrough cards (Batching, Caching, Quant) with copy and CTA that link to the Optimize panel
Five screenshot-ready UI snippets (desktop and mobile widths) exported as PNG + SVG, with 2x and 3x density variants
Tooltip copy finalized and engineering-ready token names for toggles and badges
Figma file handed off with organized components and annotations for dev (CSS tokens, spacing, accessible color contrast)
Documentation mockups (Confluence) with embedded screenshots and recommended microcopy
progress_updates: 2025-03-05: Kickoff with PM and Eng. Aligned on scope: showcase 'recommended' profile, quick A/B variant for canary users, and CTA to run automated evaluation after applying changes.

2025-03-06: Wireframes completed for three-card layout (compact horizontal, stack for mobile). Decision: favor succinct performance numbers (median latency, token cost delta) rather than raw throughput graphs to reduce cognitive load.

2025-03-06: Trade-off discussion with eng: live KV-cache diagram will be simplified to a single animated frame showing prefix-hit vs miss; full telemetry will surface in Console later (follow-up ENG dependency).

2025-03-07: Design review with PM Maya. Feedback: change 'Aggressive quant' label to 'High quant (smaller model, lower precision)' for clarity; adjust contrast on badges for AA accessibility. Incorporated feedback and updated components.
2025-03-07: Handoff checklist created — include export specs, copy strings file, and feature flags for A/B test. Blocker: need final API names from ENG for toggles (dependency ENG-4022).
